title: PELDRUN Provider Catalog
description: JSON Schema for the remote catalog consumed by PELDRUN via PELDRUN_PROVIDER_CATALOG_URL.

schema_version.description: Catalog format version. Currently only 1 is supported.

description.description: Human-readable description of the catalog's purpose.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last catalog update.

id.description: Unique, filesystem-safe, URL-safe identifier. Must match the provider package's manifest id.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name shown in the UI.

description.description: One-line summary shown on the catalog card.

version.description: Semantic version of the provider package (must match the ZIP's manifest).

transport.description: Adapter transport type declared in the manifest.

features.description: Feature flags advertised by the package (vision, tool_calling, reasoning, ...).

permissions.description: Permission declaration mirrored from the manifest. Used to render warnings in the install dialog.

brand_color.description: Hex brand colour used by the store UI (e.g. '#21A038').

icon.description: Icon identifier - either a built-in icon name or an image URL, depending on icon_type.

icon_type.description: How the 'icon' field should be interpreted: 'name' for a bundled icon, 'url' for a remote image.

download_url.description: HTTPS URL of the ZIP archive. Required for installability.

checksum_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the ZIP at download_url. Required for installability.

name.description: Display name of the developer or publisher.

verified.description: Whether the publisher has been verified by the catalog maintainers.

developer.description: Developer / publisher identity shown in the install dialog.

repository_url.description: HTTPS URL of the provider's public source repository.

tags.description: Free-form tags used for filtering in the store UI.

connection_fields.description: Optional snapshot of the manifest's connection_fields. Renders the Configure form for preview-only items.

certificates.description: Optional snapshot of the manifest's certificates. Alerts the user to TLS setup cost before installing.
